_help: Offers and payment options that cannot be read from a store's public pages (they sit behind its checkout) or that were verified by hand. Add what you see on a store's payment page: bank / card offers, coupon codes, wallet cashback. Every entry needs 'text' and 'source' (where you saw it) and 'seenAt' (YYYY-MM-DD). kind is one of: sale, coupon, bank, card, wallet, emi, shipping, credit, info. Optional: code (a coupon code), bank (issuer or wallet name), upTo (rupees, for 'up to' savings or cashback), conditions, url, endsOn (YYYY-MM-DD). Entries past endsOn are dropped on import. The daily update merges this file into the live store data. Never add an offer you have not seen on the store itself.
